findings.title: CouchDB 3.5.3 Release Announcement (Security Fixes)
findings.summary_md: The official CouchDB blog announced version 3.5.3 as a maintenance release that includes fixes for several security vulnerabilities. The post mentions CVE IDs for tracking but does not detail the specific CVSS scores or exploitation status.

findings.title: CVE-2026-86471: Apache CouchDB Admin-to-OS Command Execution (oss-security)
findings.summary_md: The oss-security mailing list entry from 2026/10/20 (message #11) reports CVE-2026-86471: an unvalidated runtime configuration value in Apache CouchDB 3.5.2 and below allows a server admin to run arbitrary shell commands as the CouchDB OS user. The advisory was authored by Jan Lehnardt (jan@apache.org).

findings.title: CVE-2026-86471 Advisory (VulDB)
findings.summary_md: VulDB lists CVE-2026-86471 with advisory disclosure on 2026-10-20, vendor apache.org, status not defined at time of entry, and links it to the CouchDB improper authentication vulnerability affecting versions 3.5.2 and below.
